training_data.name: NVIDIA Aegis AI Content Safety Dataset 2.0
training_data.quote: Training Subset: 1000 samples randomly selected from the full dataset

training_method.update_scope_quote: Fine-tuning Method: LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) ... Quantization: 4-bit NF4

description.text:
This is a fine-tuned version of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, specialized for content safety and moderation tasks. The model was fine-tuned using LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) on the NVIDIA Aegis AI Content Safety Dataset 2.0, which contains diverse examples of safe and unsafe content across multiple categories.

DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B is a distilled version of DeepSeek-R1, optimized for efficiency while maintaining strong reasoning and language understanding capabilities. This makes it ideal for content moderation tasks that require both speed and accuracy.

output_type.quote: Content safety classification - Identify safe vs unsafe content

use_claim.quote: specialized for content safety and moderation tasks

warning.quote: Not a Replacement for Human Judgment: Should be used as part of a comprehensive moderation system

serving.text_only_input_quote: Analyze this content for safety: 'Hello! How can I help you today?'
serving.notes: generation_config.json sets temperature 0.6, top_p 0.95, and do_sample true. The card's example instead uses temperature 0.7, top_p 0.95, do_sample true, and max_new_tokens 128. Training max sequence length is 512. tokenizer_config.json model_max_length is 16384. config.json max_position_embeddings is 131072. The chat template is the DeepSeek-R1 template; use_default_system_prompt is false and the template's system string starts empty. The repo has model.safetensors (1,777,088,000 float16 parameters) and no adapter_config.json.

evaluation_reported.text: The model was evaluated on a held-out test set from the Aegis AI Content Safety Dataset: Perplexity 14.20, test set size 100 samples, method perplexity calculation plus qualitative generation testing.

discrepancies: Inventory methods is lora. The card states LoRA and also 4-bit NF4 quantization during training, which is QLoRA. The dataset id and the parent match the inventory.
